በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine')
እምሀገረ: ሀገር — from the city of (እም- + noun, construct)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ምድረ: ምድር — earth, land (noun, construct state 'land-of') · accusative 'a land', 'the ground' (ምድረ ነኪረ 'a foreign land'; እከሪ ምድረ 'I dig the ground')
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ለሰብአ: ሰብእ — the men of (ለ- + noun, construct 'men-of'; the ለ- marks the object, doubling the suffix on the verb)
ለሀገረ: ሀገር — for the city of, over the city of (ለ- + noun, construct)
ወአማሰኑ: አማሰነ — and they destroyed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ማሰነ 'perish')
ኪያሃ: ኪያሃ — her (accusative independent pronoun, 3fs; object of ያኀድጉነ)
ተመይጠት: ተመይጠ — it turned (3fs perfect, Gt stem of ሜጠ 'turn', root m-y-ṭ)
ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city') · accusative of place 'in the city' (ይነብር ሀገረ 'he would stay in the city')
ወረደ: ወረደ — he went down, descended (3ms perfect, G, w-r-d) · ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
አድባረ: ደብር — mountains of (plural አድባር of ደብር 'mountain', construct)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ይቤልዎ: ብህለ — they said to him (3mp perf. ይቤሉ + ሎ 'to him', written ይቤልዎ)
ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died'
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — woman, wife (noun, fem., construct / accusative)
ወሀለወት: ሀሎ — and she is present, there is (ወ- + 3fs perfect)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
እኁሁ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
ወይነ: ወይን — wine (noun, accusative) · 'vine' (ትተክል ወይነ 'you will plant a vine')
ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
በአይቴ: አይቴ — by what, in what (በ- + interrogative 'where, what')
ይጠፍእ: ጠፍአ — he/it vanishes, perishes (3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
በፍኖት: ፍኖት — on the road, in the way (በ- + noun, fem.)
ወለነኒ: ለ — and as for us too (ወ- + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us' + -ኒ 'also')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
በዝየ: ዝየ — here (በ- + adverb ዝየ 'here'; the በ- adds nothing to the sense)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown')
ትልህቅ: ልህቀ — who grows great, is the elder (3fs imperfect, G, l-h-q, after እንተ) (?)
ለወለቱ: ወለት — to his daughter (ለ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted -ቱ)
እምብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — from his wife (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', spelled -ቱ)
ወደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — and his children, sons (ወ- + noun + -u 'his')
ውሉዶ: ውሉድ — his son (noun ውሉድ 'son, begotten', which also serves as plural of ወልድ, + -ሁ '3ms his'; anticipates the genitive ለአቡየ)
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, construct state 'sin-of') · accusative object, 'sin' (ያአትት ኀጢአተ 'he takes away sin')
ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
ወሰመየቶ: ሰመየ — and she named him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
ተዐውቀ: ዐወቀ — it was/has become known (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ዐወቀ 'know' (?); rendered as a present 'it is known')
ወለደት: ወለደ — she bore, gave birth (3fs perfect)
ትንእስ: ንእሰ — who is small, least (3fs imperfect, G; after እንተ relative)
ለአቡነ: አብ — to our father (ለ- + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
ወአንቲኒ: አንቲ — and you also (ወ- + 2fs independent pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return')
ትረክቢ: ረከበ — you will find (2fs imperfect, G)
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ይእቲኒ: ይእቲ — she too (3fs independent pronoun + emphatic -ኒ)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
ሤም: ሴም — Shem (proper name; spelled ሤም here)
